howToScan.q: How do I scan a medication?
howToScan.a: Open the Scan tab, tap 'Open Camera', point at your medicine label, and tap the capture button. The app will analyze the image and show you information about the medication.

offlineMode.a: Yes! Once you've scanned medications with internet, they're saved for offline access. The pharmacy locator also works offline using cached data.

languages.a: Currently, EchoRx supports English, Yoruba, Hausa, and Igbo. More Nigerian languages and international languages are coming soon.

accuracy.q: How accurate is the medication scanner?
accuracy.a: Our AI scanner is highly accurate but not perfect. Always verify important information with your pharmacist or doctor.

privacy.a: Yes! All your medication data is stored locally on your device. We don't collect or share your health information.

pharmacies.q: Where does pharmacy data come from?
pharmacies.a: Pharmacy locations are sourced from OpenStreetMap, a free and open map database. Data is regularly updated.
